label: Design Voice
description: Generate voice previews from a text description (age, accent, tone, character). Each preview carries its audio and a preview id; wire the one you like into Create Voice to mint it as a durable voice.

types.VoicePreview: { voiceId: String, audio: Audio, durationSecs?: Number, language?: String }

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account (designed voices live in it; the shared credential cannot serve this).

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: What the voice should sound like.
inputs.placeholder: A calm, deep male narrator with a slight British accent

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The preview line to speak. Absent = a fitting line is generated.

outputs.name: previews
outputs.description: The generated previews: audio + the preview id Create Voice takes.
